patterns.note: Content sections frequently use an asymmetrical two-column layout, pairing large, high-quality food photography with descriptive text blocks.
Prominent, large, sans-serif headings are used for main section titles, often in a light color against a darker background or vice-versa, establishing clear visual hierarchy.
The site consistently uses an earthy color palette, combining light beige and white backgrounds with vibrant greens for accents, calls-to-action, and key branding elements.
The hero section features a background image that scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground text and CTA, creating a subtle parallax effect.
The primary navigation bar at the top of the page shrinks in height and maintains its position as a sticky element after the user scrolls past the initial hero section.
Sections are clearly delineated by alternating background colors (light beige, white, and a soft green), providing visual breaks and guiding the user down the page.

technique_notes: The hero image uses a parallax scrolling effect where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, creating a sense of depth. The main navigation bar transitions to a more compact, sticky state with a subtle background color change after the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

Content sections are structured with a flexible two-column grid, allowing for large, impactful imagery to be balanced with concise, informative text, often with the image taking up more horizontal space.

Typography establishes hierarchy through a combination of oversized, modern sans-serif headings and a highly legible sans-serif for body text, with occasional use of smaller, uppercase labels for sub-headers.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body text) with smaller, uppercase labels for subheadings, creating a clear hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: subtle (slightly rounded corners on buttons and input fields)
design_tokens.spacing: balanced (comfortable padding around elements and sections, with an airy hero section)

standout: The site stands out with its use of high-quality, natural food photography that feels authentic and inviting, paired with a clean, modern layout and a distinctive earthy-green and beige color palette. The subtle parallax effect on the hero image adds a touch of sophistication without being distracting.
